wh.quote: Battery capacity is another reason to know exactly which D5 you’re looking at. The D5 Zebra uses a 960Wh Samsung/LG battery, with Himiway advertising up to 80 miles of range under favorable conditions. Here’s where newer doesn’t necessarily mean bigger. The D5 2.0 uses a 48V 15Ah Samsung/LG battery, or 720Wh. That’s considerably less capacity than the Zebra’s 960Wh pack.
